polaco.name: Polish
polaco.description: 52-card French deck. 2s and 3s stack draws, 4s stack skips, J demands a number, A demands a suit, Q is a wild card, K♥ and K♠ attack. You can play runs and groups of 3 or more cards. Whoever is left with 1 card announces it with an automatic Macao!

handSize.help: Between 3 and 10. Cards per player × players can't exceed 40.

rule.kingOnlyRespond: You can only respond with {card} or accept and draw 5.
rule.skipPending: You have a pending skip: play a 4 or accept losing your turn.
rule.drawPending: You have a pending draw: respond with a 2 or a 3, or accept and draw.

rule.noQUnderJ: You can't play a Q under a J demand.
rule.demandRank: You're being asked for {rank}s: play any {rank} (of any suit) or another J.
rule.qUnderAce: Under an A demand, the only valid Q is the {suit} one.
rule.demandSuit: You're being asked for {suit}: play a card of that suit or another A.
rule.noFit: That card doesn't match {card}: it has to match the suit or the rank.
rule.waitingKing: Waiting for {name} to respond to the K.
rule.kingMulti: A pending K can only be answered with the opposite K (a single card) or by accepting.
rule.multiShape: Several cards must form a run (consecutive numbers) or a group of the same rank.
rule.multiMin: To play several cards you need at least 3 (a run or a group of the same rank).
rule.drawGroupOnly: With a pending draw only a group of 2s or 3s can respond (or accept).
rule.skipGroupOnly: With a pending skip only a group of 4s can respond (or accept).
rule.firstFirst: Put first the card that matches the table.
rule.firstMustPlay: The first card must be playable on its own. {reason}

rule.pickSuit: Pick the suit you want to demand.
rule.drawPendingAccept: You have something pending: accept to draw.
rule.alreadyDrew: You've already drawn this turn: play that card or pass.
rule.deckEmpty: There are no cards left to draw.
rule.passOnly: You can only pass after drawing a playable card.
